reason: The cited evidence shows that cryo-rolling and annealing can create a heterogeneous microstructure with improved strength-ductility synergy in certain HEAs, supporting the first two premises. However, the evidence is from different alloy systems (E1: an unspecified EHEA; E2: CoCrFeNi2.1Nb0.2) and does not address the effect on a caloric phase transformation, leaving the third and fifth premises unsupported. The fourth premise on reduction level is not directly supported by the cited passages, which use 90% reduction.
premises: Cryo-rolling followed by annealing can produce a heterogeneous microstructure with deformed and recrystallized regions in HEAs
Such a heterogeneous microstructure enhances strength-ductility synergy
The proposed cryo-rolling and annealing treatment will not significantly alter the bulk phase transformation responsible for the caloric effect
A 30–50% reduction is sufficient to refine the microstructure and improve mechanical integrity
The specific alloy (MnNiSi)0.62(FeCoGe)0.38 will respond to cryo-rolling and annealing similarly to the cited HEAs
